in_marathi.name: Baleshwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Strength
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baleshwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baleshwar is a compound name derived from two Sanskrit words: 'Bala' meaning strength and 'Ishwar' meaning god or lord. The name is a reverence to Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the embodiment of strength and power. Baleshwar is a name for a boy that reflects courage, power, and divine protection.
